## Contribution

What does this change or teach us? Unsolicited ideas, replications, bug fixes,
documentation and negative results are welcome. No linked issue is required.

## Evidence

What did you actually test? Include reproduction commands, reference/version and
small reports when relevant. Do not claim checks you did not run.

## Limits and failures

What remains unknown or failed? Does this change evaluation rules, case data,
scientific thresholds, permissions or dependencies? Explain those separately.

## Attribution

Credit upstream code/data and people; identify applicable licenses.

## Optional context

Related research hint, hardware, compute cost, tools/models — all optional.
Neither a declared budget nor a requested task is a condition for consideration.
